LABUAN FINANCIAL SERVICES AND SECURITIES ACT 2010

LABUAN FINANCIAL SERVICES AND SECURITIES (AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS 2022

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 196 of the
Labuan Financial Services  and Securities Act 2010 [ Act 704 ], the Minister,
on the recommendation of the Authority, makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Labuan Financial Services
and Securities (Amendment) Regulations 2022.

 (2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 January 2023.

Substitution of Third Schedule
2. The Labuan Financial Services and Securities Regulations 2010
[P.U. (A) 416/2010] are amended by substituting for the Third Schedule
the following schedule:
